title: Fake CBI officer, Aadhaar money-laundering case, Skype video
turns: Hello, am I speaking to Kamala madam? This is Inspector Rajesh Verma from CBI, New Delhi.
Madam, your Aadhaar card is linked to a money-laundering case. 68 bank accounts were opened with it.
An arrest warrant has been issued in your name. This is a digital arrest, you cannot disconnect.
Do not tell anyone in your family. Join me on Skype video call now, keep the camera on.
To prove your innocence you must transfer Rs 4,50,000 to the RBI safe account for verification.
Note down. Account number 5021 0034 7781 9920. Bank is HDFC.
Yes yes. Do it fast madam, the officer is waiting.
After transfer send screenshot on WhatsApp to 98200 11223.
